    def solve(self):
        data = sys.stdin.read().split()
        it = iter(data)
        N = int(next(it))
        cnt = [0] * 26
        move = 0
        str_val = next(it)
        b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(N)]
        res = sum(b)
        for i in range(N // 2):
            if str_val[i] == str_val[N - i - 1]:
                cnt[ord(str_val[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
                move += 1
                res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1])
        for i in range(26):
            if cnt[i] > move // 2:
                left = cnt[i] * 2 - move
                pos = []
                for j in range(N // 2):
                    if str_val[j] != str_val[N - j - 1]:
                        if ord(str_val[N - j - 1]) - ord('a') == i or ord(str_val[j]) - ord('a') == i:
                            pass  # commented out code
                        else:
                            pos.append(min(b[N - j - 1], b[j]))
                pos.sort()
                for j in range(left):
                    res -= pos[j]
        print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver = AntiPalindrome()
    solver.solve()
